captions.detailed: A realistic matte black cine lens featuring a cylindrical, non-extending main barrel body with a tapered profile. It includes two rotating control rings: a central focus ring and a lower iris ring, both designed to rotate continuously around the main optical axis. The top of the lens features a wide, flat front bezel enclosing a glossy, dark glass element.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cine lens with a matte black non-extending barrel body. It should feature a central focus ring and a lower iris control ring, both configured with continuous revolute joints, and a realistic front glass element.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly starting with a main barrel body using stacked and boolean-subtracted Cylinder primitives to form the stepped lens casing. A separate glass element is created using a thin cylinder with a reflective material. Two independent control rings (focus and iris) are modeled as concentric hollow cylinders, positioned along the Z-axis, and linked to the main barrel body via continuous revolute joints.
